snippet.title: We created brand new FREE word game for Twitch!
snippet.description:
A brand new word game has bee launched to allow Twitch chat to play along. Chat must work together to find the Buzzword within the alloted round. Fail to find it and everybldy loses their points. With many settings designed to suit you stream and play style, check it out now:

buzzword.tv
